notes: Trust-the-screenshot normalization. (1) Canvas is NOT white: the page sits on a warm tan/cream — rgb(225,215,194)=#e1d7c2 (most frequent backgroundColor, count 17) for the main field and rgb(238,239,233)=#eef0e9 for the lighter card/cream surface; pure white (#fff, count 7) is used only for a few inset panels, so it is demoted to surface-2. (2) The single most-used color in the WHOLE profile is rgb(77,79,70)=#4d4f46 (color count 682 + borderColor count 632) — a warm near-black that is primarily the outline color on every cell/chip/window; it is promoted to a first-class 'border' role (heavier-used than any background). Body ink is the slightly darker/greener rgb(35,37,29)=#23251d. NOTE rgb(55,65,81)=#374151 and rgb(17,24,39)=#111827 (Tailwind slate/gray-900, counts 276/79) appear but read as embedded code-sample / default UI text, not the page's warm ink — folded into fg, not listed separately. (3) Muted text rgb(101,103,94)=#65675e; lighter placeholder/subtle rgb(158,160,150)=#9ea096 (the on-tan contrast risk flagged in the exemplar). (4) ONE brand accent: orange-red rgb(245,78,0)=#f54e00 (CTAs + links, backgroundColor count 8 / color count 6). Gold rgb(247,165,1)=#f7a501 is the secondary. The remaining hues — cyan #30abc6, magenta #b62ad9, green #6aa84f, teal #29dbbb, amber #eb9d2a — are product-CATEGORY coding (each appears ~2-12x as icon-cell fills/borders), kept as cat-* roles, not core palette or emphasis. (5) Font: 'Open Runde' is the only real face (count 1041); the mono fallbacks (counts 6/1) are for code samples. No serif anywhere. (6) Type scale collapsed from noisy px (16 body dominant; 15/14/13/12 secondary; 24 headings; 36 hero) to a tight rem ramp — range is only ~2.25x, hierarchy is NOT scale-driven (it's enclosure + fill-color). Sub-pixel sizes (21.43px, 19.29px) are computed fractions, dropped. (7) Negative tracking (-0.6px) applies only to the largest display sizes; body is 0. (8) Tight spacing base ≈4px (gaps cluster 4/6/2/8px; section padding jumps to 16/24/48/64). (9) Radii are small/sharp (2/4/6px) for the comic-panel cells, plus full-pill (9999px) for some chips/avatars — this is a low-roundness system despite the rounded font. (10) Motion: one real transition, 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) (Material standard, count 42) for hovers, plus one 0.3s — no scroll/spectacle animation. (11) Only one boxShadow of note (a -12px lift on a couple of floating panels, count 4); the design is essentially shadowless and relies on outlines instead. (12) MOTION/CRAFT AUGMENT (2026-06-24): motion block expanded from the raw `.motion` capture + frame sequence s00-s10. Reframed honestly as functional, NOT scroll-spectacle — the page does not scrollytell; choreography is pervasive in-view reveal (233 IO targets), an in-view category-row recolor, pinned chrome (menu bar + cookie banner), tiny scroll-scale on two hero accents, and continuous ambient illustration idle loops. Durations 2000/3000ms belong to those ambient loops, 150/300ms to state/transition. Reduced motion is NOT respected (0 PRM blocks) — flagged as a defect. Tracking corrected to proportional (~-2.5% above body, 0 on body — not one constant em).
